parent_control: V19 retained L40S stock-vLLM AWQ BF16 arm
causal_hypothesis: The 32,768-token scheduler budget forces eight simultaneous 8,192-token prefills into at least two token-budget waves. Raising only max_num_batched_tokens to 65,536 may reduce queueing and improve c8 SLO-goodput while preserving c1, quality, and semantics.
candidate_change: Return activation dtype to bfloat16 and set only vLLM --max-num-batched-tokens from 32768 to 65536. Checkpoint, runtime, all other server flags, and workloads remain fixed.
expected_direction: At least 5% c8 throughput improvement is useful. C1 may not regress by more than 3%. Any semantic, paired-quality, exact-geometry, SLO, or memory failure rejects the candidate.

workload.semantic: two exact temperature-zero alpha/beta JSON requests
workload.c1: 4 requests, concurrency 1, exact 8192 input and 1024 output tokens
workload.c8: 16 requests, concurrency 8, exact 8192 input and 1024 output tokens

artifact_contract: Distinct V21 archive and internal manifest; model/runtime/server/scheduler identity; semantic, paired quality/NLL, c1/c8 rows, metrics, telemetry, conditional trace; retain only if another arm starts within ten minutes; final owner deletes instance/disk and verifies zero.
stop_rules: OOM, semantic, quality, exact-geometry, or SLO failure rejects. Less than 5% c8 gain is neutral/reject. Any harness error opens a ten-minute in-place repair window; do not repeat unchanged.
